notes: SCREEN ADJUST (original scene 0: init 0x132d8, adjust 0x131d0, question 0x130ee, draw 0x13004; sprites 0x1d6e00 and 0x1d6e38).

Left and right move the picture one unit a step (range_x), up and down likewise (range_y); the ends do not wrap. The offset is the game options' screen_offset, and the whole picture follows it as it changes.
layers move with the picture; fixed sprites are drawn at their position minus the offset, so they hold still, as the original draws them.

reset centres the picture silently. Confirm asks the question: YES keeps the offset, NO puts back the one the screen started with; either way the screen fades out to exit_to. Cancel only answers NO in the question.
The horizontal step plays sys entry 4 (move_x), the vertical one and the question's choice entry 3.
